title: Separate two voices with PIT
brief: Write the permutation-invariant loss and a small Conv-TasNet, then train it to pull a chirp and a vowel train out of a mixture.
hints: pit_loss: compute the C x C matrix of -SI-SDR between every output and every reference once, with broadcasting, then score each permutation from itertools.permutations by indexing that matrix.
tcn_receptive_field: each dilated conv adds (kernel - 1) * dilation frames, and the dilations 1, 2, ..., 2**(X - 1) sum to 2**X - 1.
TinyConvTasNet.forward: the encoder with kernel L and stride L/2 covers length + stride * (frames - 1) samples, so pad the input up to that and trim the decoder's output back to T.
